title: Electric Demon in Thorns
description: A dark purple demonic creature with glowing blue energy stands crouched in the center of a chaotic mass of twisted, thorny branches and roots. Bright blue electrical arcs and sparks emanate from the figure, illuminating the surrounding dark tangle of organic forms.
prompt: A menacing demonic creature with dark purple skin and sharp features crouches in the center of a dense, chaotic nest of twisted thorny branches and roots. Bright blue electrical energy arcs and sparks violently around its body, casting dramatic light on the surrounding dark organic tangle, moody cinematic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere
